 How to Watch Warriors vs Timberwolves

 Golden State picked up its first win of the season Monday, beating the Denver Nuggets 134-114 behind a strong performance from rookie Yaxel Lendeborg. The forward scored 31 points, grabbed 12 rebounds and added six assists, while Stephen Curry scored 24 points without missing a shot, going 8-for-8 from the field and 3-for-3 from three-point range. Brandin Podziemski added 18 points, seven rebounds and five assists as the Warriors shot 54.1% from the field and made 22 three-pointers. Golden State scored 40 points in the third quarter to take control after being up by just four at halftime.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Minnesota lost its first game of the season Monday, 127-125 to the Cleveland Cavaliers in overtime despite another big game from Anthony Edwards, who scored 47 points on 19-for-33 shooting, adding four rebounds, four assists and two blocks. Jaden McDaniels and Terrence Shannon Jr. each scored 14 points, while Joan Beringer finished with 12 points and seven rebounds. The Timberwolves led 60-50 at halftime but allowed Cleveland to tie the game in the fourth quarter.
